motion.name: menu-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile burger panel open and close.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 20px; width: max-content; cursor: pointer; background-color: var(--color-primary); color: #000000; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 1px 0px 10px 2px var(--color-primary); transition: all 0.5s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Invert Button
components.css: .ds-btn-invert { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 20px; width: max-content; cursor: pointer; background-color: transparent; color: var(--color-primary); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-invert:hover { color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 1px 0px 10px 2px var(--color-primary); transition: all 0.5s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-invert:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Experience Card
components.description: Bordered slate card for a role or project.
components.css: .ds-card { margin: 20px; background-color: #27262F; padding: 20px 20px 20px 30px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); display: flex; flex-direction: column; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { color: #808080; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Nav Tab
components.description: Header navigation item; underlined when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { display: flex; margin: 0 20px; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; text-decoration-color: var(--color-primary); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; transform: scale(1); transition: transform 0.3s; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-tab:hover, .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { color: var(--color-primary); transform: scale(1.2); } .ds-nav-tab[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Company Logo Chip
components.description: White logo tile bordered in the accent, used on experience cards.
components.css: .ds-logo { width: 140px; height: 29px; object-fit: contain; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 10px; padding: 5px; margin-bottom: 10px; }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a dark workspace lit by one electric accent. The page sits on near-black and every piece of interactive emphasis is drawn in a single user-tunable accent. Density is low; headings are large and bold; body copy is small and quiet. The code-CV modal borrows an IDE look for the resume itself. Interaction is expressive, presentation is restrained.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, changeable at runtime, used for all emphasis.
Dark-only surfaces; no light theme exists.
Flat at rest; accent glow and scale on interaction.
Bold system sans for headings; monospace reserved for the code-CV modal.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent is the only saturated color. Its rarity is the point; do not introduce a second accent.

rules.name: The Variable Accent Rule
rules.body: Never hard-code the accent. Reference var(--color-primary) so the visitor's theme choice propagates.

rules.name: The Monospace Containment Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only inside the code-CV modal. Do not use it for page headings or body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to hover or focus.

dos: Do reference var(--color-primary) for every accent use.
Do keep the page background at #17161D and cards at #27262F.
Do use the pill (20px) radius for buttons and 10px for cards.
Do keep hover effects to accent glow, scale, or color shift.
Do keep headings in the system sans at 700 weight.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent.
Don't use monospace outside the code-CV modal.
Don't add drop shadows to cards at rest.
Don't hard-code the mint hex in components; use the variable.
Don't add light-theme surfaces; the system is dark-only.
Don't treat one-off decorative gradients as system tokens.
